65144.subject: Geography
65144.question_text: The following are advantages of overpopulation except
65144.explanation: Insufficient food is a disadvantage of overpopulation because as a result of the high influx of people into an area, there will not be sufficient food to cater for the high population which leads to food shortage, especially in developing countries

65146.subject: Geography
65146.question_text: Which of the following is best defined as the movement of people from one geographical area to another involving permanent or temporary residence or settlement
65146.explanation: Migration is the movement of people from one geographical area to another involving permanent or temporary residence or settlement

65148.subject: Geography
65148.question_text:
Use the information on country Y below to answer the question that follows:

Land area = 200,000km \(^{2}\)
Population = 10,000,000.

calculate the population density of country Y
65148.explanation:
Population density of country Y = Total population of country Y/Land Area of country Y
Population density of country Y = 10,000,000 persons/200,000 km2=50 persons per km2

65150.subject: Geography
65150.question_text: The birth rate of a country can be increased through the following except
65150.explanation: Inadequacy of health services is very common in developing countries. This will lead to a high mortality rate in such country

65151.subject: Geography
65151.question_text: The following are areas of lowlands in Nigeria except in Nigeria
65151.explanation: The Eastern Scarpland is an area of highlands in Nigeria. It is found within the eastern region of Nigeria, especially around Enugu and Nsukka. The major highland in this area is the Udi-Nsukka Plateau(300-600m)

65156.subject: Geography
65156.question_text: The wind which blows across the Atlantic Ocean towards the coast of Nigeria and is responsible for rainy season is known as
65156.explanation: The equatorial Easterlies blows around the equator from the east, land breeze blows from the land to the sea, sea breeze blows from the sea to the land. The Tropical continental airmass blows across the sahara desert towards Nigeria but the Tropical maritime airmass blows across the Atlantic ocean towards the coast of Nigeria and is responsible for rainy season

65157.subject: Geography
65157.question_text: Which of the following is not a major river basin in Nigeria?
65157.explanation: River basin refers to the area generally drained by a river and its tributaries. All other options are major river basins in Nigeria except the Sokoto basin

65159.subject: Geography
65159.question_text: Tin-mining activities in Nigeria are the main causes of environmental degradation on the?
65159.explanation: JosPlateau falls in the North-Central highlands. Mining is an economic activity in Jos due to the presence of mineral resources like Tin. Tin-Mining activities results in the environmental degradation on the Jos Plateau

65160.subject: Geography
65160.question_text: The high cost of lumbering operations in tropical forest is mainly due to?
65160.explanation: In the tropical forest, there is the absence of pure stands of trees. In other words, in the tropical forest, the plant population do not consist largely of members of one specie, variety or type.

options.text: Absence of pure stands of trees

65162.subject: Geography
65162.question_text: Which of the following farming activity best describes the rearing of only animals like cattle, sheep and goat mainly in the savanna belt of the north?
65162.explanation: Pastoral farming, also referred to as nomadic herding is the rearing of only animals like cattle, sheep and goat. It is mainly practised in the savanna belt of the north, especially in the sudan savanna

65163.subject: Geography
65163.question_text: The outer structure of the earth is made up of the following except?
65163.explanation: The atmosphere, biosphere and hydrosphere are all outer structure of the earth. The Mesosphere also known as the mantle is an internal structure of the earth which is found beneath the crust and surrounds the core(Barysphere)

65164.subject: Geography
65164.question_text: Which of the following is an importance of the atmosphere to living organisms?
65164.explanation:
option A is an importance of the Hydrosphere
option C is an importance of the Biosphere
option D is an importance of the Lithosphere
The Atmosphere is the gaseous portion of the earth. It is associated with the provision of gases required by living things e.g oxygen for combustion and respiration, nitrogen for protein synthesis by plants etc.

options.text: It provides water for industrial uses
It provides oxygen for animals and plants for respiration
It provides shelter in form of timber for man
It aids transportation through construction of roads and railways

65165.subject: Geography
65165.question_text: The correct arrangement of the layers of the earth crust from the surface to the interior is
65165.explanation: The crust is subdivided into the upper part, containing minerals like silica, iron and magnesium(sima). The mantle is found beneath the crust and the core is surrounded by the mantle. Hence, the correct arrangement of the layers of the earth crust "sial, sima, mantle and core" from the surface to the interior.

65166.subject: Geography
65166.question_text: If the scale of a map is 2cm to 1km, what is the ground distance if the distance between two towns on the map is 20cm
65166.explanation:
map distance = 20cm, ground distance = Y
map scale = 2cm to 1km
since 2cm ≡ 1km
20cm ≡ Y
2Y = 20km
Y = 20km/2=10km
The ground distance between the two towns is 10km

65167.subject: Geography
65167.question_text: If the scale of two maps are (a;1:100,000 and b;1:400,000) what is the ground distance if the distance between two towns on the maps is 10cm
65167.explanation:
map distance = 10cm, ground distance = ?
Map scale for (a) 1:100,000
Ground distance = 10 x 100,000/100,000 =10km
Map scale for (b) 1:400,000
Ground distance = 10 x 400,000/100,000 =40km

65169.subject: Geography
65169.question_text: Which of the following is a reason for the high volume of trade between Nigeria and developed countries?
65169.explanation: The inclination of some developing countries to their colonial masters has helped to increase the volume of trade between the nations

65171.subject: Geography
65171.question_text: The following are seaports used in the North Atlantic sea route except
65171.explanation:
The sea route through which Nigeria and Europe exchange their products is through the North Atlantic sea route and the following seaports are used:
Lagos-Antwerp(Belgium), Lagos-Rotterdam(Netherlands), Lagos-Hamburg(West Germany), Lagos-Southampton(Britain) while the sea route through which Nigeria and America exchange their products is the south Atlantic route and seaport used is Lagos-Montreal(Canada)

65172.subject: Geography
65172.question_text: _______ is the condition of the lower atmosphere of a place over a short period
65172.explanation: Weather is the condition of the lower atmosphere of a place over a short period. The weather of a place is always very brief and changes regularly e.g the weather of today could be sunny, rainy or cloudy etc.

65173.subject: Geography
65173.question_text: In a combined maximum and minimum thermometer, the difference between the hottest and coldest daily temperature for that day gives the
65173.explanation:
Diurnal range of temperature = Max.temperature - Mini.temperature for that day
Maximum daily temperature ≡ Hottest daily temperature
Minimum daily temperature ≡ Coldest daily temperature

65174.subject: Geography
65174.question_text: _______ is defined as the total surrounding or medium of any organism in a given area
65174.explanation: Environment is defined as the total surrounding or medium of any organism in a given area. This includes the physical surroundings, climatic factors and other living organisms in that surroundings

65175.subject: Geography
65175.question_text: Which of the following processes leads to the loss of carbon from the air
65175.explanation: carbon dioxide is removed from the air during photosynthesis as green plants use it to manufacture their food

65176.subject: Geography
65176.question_text: On maps, lines drawn to join all places in the ocean having equal degree of salinity are called
65176.explanation: Isohalines are lines drawn on maps to join all places in the ocean having equal degree of saltiness or concentration of salt or salinity

65177.subject: Geography
65177.question_text: Where the salinity of an ocean is high;
65177.explanation: Salinity is one of the causes of ocean currents. Where the salinity of an ocean is high, the ocean water is dense or heavy and creeps(or moves) at the bottom of the ocean to low salinity areas.

options.text: the ocean water is dense and flows at the ocean surface towards a low salinity area
the ocean water is dense and creeps at the bottom of the ocean towards low salinity areas
the ocean water is light and flows at the area surface towards a high salinity area
the ocean water is light and flows at the ocean surface towards a low salinity area

65178.subject: Geography
65178.question_text: The type of water left in the soil after excess water has been drained off, following heavy rainfall is known as
65178.explanation: Field capacity is the type of water left in the soil after excess water has been drained off, following heavy rainfall. This water is available to all plants.

65180.subject: Geography
65180.question_text: The part labelled X in the soil profile is known as
65180.explanation: The part labelled X is called the bedrock. It contains solid parent rocks.

65181.subject: Geography
65181.question_text: Which of the following is not a graphical representation of statistical data?
65181.explanation: All except shaded map are graphical representation of statistical data

65183.subject: Geography
65183.question_text: Which of the following is a vegetation characteristics of the Tropical rainforest?
65183.explanation: In the Tropical rainforest, the trees are not in pure stand i.e scattered

options.text: Trees are not in pure stand
Tough, small, leathery, hairy leaves to guard against excessive transpiration

65185.subject: Geography
65185.question_text: Which of the following is a problem of landlocked countries
65185.explanation: Landlocked countries refer to those countries which do not have an access or boundary with the coast or oceans. Examples are Mali, Niger, Sudan, Zambia etc. Landlocked countries depend politically on other countries.

65186.subject: Geography
65186.question_text: One of the following is not a problem involved in harnessing solar energy?
65186.explanation: High cost of harnessing solar energy is a problem while adequacy of capital isn't

options.text: Fear of competition with established energy sources

65188.subject: Geography
65188.question_text: One of the following surveying instruments is used to set out lines at right angles to the main chain line
65188.explanation: Using either the mirror method or the prism square method, the optical square is used to mark out lines at right angles to the main chain line.

65190.subject: Geography
65190.question_text: ________is the failure of the end point of a closed traverse to fall exactly on the point of origin of the transverse
65190.explanation: Error of closure is the failure of the end point of a closed traverse to fall exactly on the point of origin of the transverse. This error can only be known when the field details are plotted

65191.subject: Geography
65191.question_text: What is the process of lowering and levelling of the earth surface by gradual breaking and wearing away of such earth's surfaces.
65191.explanation: Dendation involves breaking of the earth's surface hence levelling such surface through agents such as water, wind etc.

65192.subject: Geography
65192.question_text: What is the process of lowering and levelling of the earth surface by gradual breaking and wearing away of such earth's surfaces.
65192.explanation: Dendation involves breaking of the earth's surface hence levelling such surface through agents such as water, wind etc.

65193.subject: Geography
65193.question_text: Which of the following is an effect of the earth's revolution?
65193.explanation: The time taken by the earth to move round the sun(i.e complete its orbit) is fixed at 365(1/4) days which makes up a year

65195.subject: Geography
65195.question_text: The soil gains nitrogen through one of the following except
65195.explanation: Denitrification is the major way by which nitrate in the soil is lost by its conversion to gaseous nitrogen with the aid of some denitrifying bacteria

65196.subject: Geography
65196.question_text: Which of the following is a way of controlling soil erosion
65196.explanation: Contour ploughing is the making of ridges across the slope to control erosion

65197.subject: Geography
65197.question_text: __________ is a highland area which seperates the headstreams of rivers flowing in different directions but rising from the same mountainous source
65197.explanation: A Watershed is a highland area which seperates the headstreams of rivers flowing in different directions but rising from the same mountainous source

65199.subject: Geography
65199.question_text: ___________ is a layer of very fine wind-deposited sand and silt?
65199.explanation: Loess are loose, fine particles which are carried by wind and deposited outside the desert. Deposits of loess are found in North-West China

65200.subject: Geography
65200.question_text: An important mineral deposit in south Africa which has attracted a large number of white settler is
65200.explanation: Africa leads the whole world in the production of gold. South Africa is the largest producer of gold.

65202.subject: Geography
65202.question_text: Which of the following gives the correct full meaning of G.I.S?

65214.subject: Geography
65214.question_text: Which of the following statistical mapping techniques is most suitable for showing the spatial distribution of cattle in the different northern states of Nigeria?
65214.explanation: The dot map refers to a diagramatic representation of a large quantity or volume of data by means of dots. Since the spatial distribution of cattle in different northern states of Nigeria is a large volume of data, the dot map is the most suitable statistical mapping technique

65215.subject: Geography
65215.question_text: Plants in the savannah are adapted mainly to alternating periods of high and low?
65215.explanation: The savannah is characterized with summer rainfall and winter dryness. Hence, the plants in the savannah have large trunks to store water for the dry season

65216.subject: Geography
65216.question_text: The prosperity of Kenya depends on the cultivation of
65216.explanation: Kenya happens to be one of the largest producers of coffee(Top 10 ranking), Maize(Top 10 ranking) and Sisal(Top 3 ranking) in Africa

65217.subject: Geography
65217.question_text: Which of the following is not an example of mineral resources?
65217.explanation: All the listed options except latex are mineral resources. Latex is a vegetation resource

65218.subject: Geography
65218.question_text: Arrange the following scales in ascending order: 1:50,000, 1:200,000, 1:200, 1:300,000
65218.explanation: The larger the denominator of a scale, the smaller the scale and the smaller the denominator of a scale, the larger the scale. Hence, the ascending order is 1:300,000< 1:200,000< 1:50,000< 1:200

65219.subject: Geography
65219.question_text: Which of the following is not a precaution to be taken when making a compass traverse?
65219.explanation: The compass must be held horizontally, so that the edge of the card does not rub against the top of the compass

options.text: The bearing should not be observed from a position close to strongly magnetic materials
The 'back' bearing should be taken from the other end of the line and should differ from the 'on'/'forward' bearing by exactly 180\(^{o}\)
All magnetic materials should be removed from the body and pockets of the reader before the bearing is taken
The compass must be held vertically so that the edge of the card does not rub against the top of the compass

65220.subject: Geography
65220.question_text: One of the following is not a sequence of denudation
65220.explanation: The four sequences or stages of denudation are weathering, erosion, transportation and deposition

65221.subject: Geography
65221.question_text: What is the longitude of a town Y whose local time is 12:00 noon when Greenwich mean time is 6:00pm
65221.explanation:
Town Y? W|12:00noon ←(substract) Longitude(0^o)|E 6:00pm
Time difference = 6:00pm - 12:00pm = 6hours
Recall: 15o ≡ 1 hour therefore 6hours ≡ (15 x 60)o= 90o
Arrow is pointing to the west;hence, the latitude of Town Y is 90oW

65222.subject: Geography
65222.question_text: Which of the following food chains is impossible?
65222.explanation: The toad cannot consume grass and the grasshopper can't also consume the toad

65223.explanation: Deforestation is the cutting down of trees and it lead to soil erosion. Contour ploughing, cover-cropping and afforestation all prevent and control soil erosion

65224.subject: Geography
65224.question_text: Which of the following is not an importance of Geographic Information System(G.I.S)
65224.explanation: Funds mismanagement is not an importance of Geographic Information System(G.I.S)

65225.subject: Geography

65225.explanation: Spurs are projection of highlands into low grounds. They separate one valley from another

65226.explanation: A laccolith is one of the main intrusive land form of vulcanicity. It is a large mass of igneous mound with a dome-shaped upper surface and a level base

65227.explanation: The instrument used in measuring the intensity of an earthquake is seismograph. It records the vibrations produced by an earthquake

65228.explanation: An arete is a wall-ridge-like structure seperating two corries

65229.subject: Geography

65229.explanation: To site a settlement, the soil must be fertile to promote agricultural activities

65230.explanation: A conurbation is the name given to two or more towns/cities which have grown to merge with one another e.g Lagos-Ikeja(Nigeria), New York-Philadelphia(U.S.A) etc.

65231.explanation: Through trade liberilazation, ECOWAS has been able to promote trade among member states

In West Africa, plantation are on fertile lowlands

65241.explanation: The deflection of winds is an effect of the earth's rotation and it does not prove the earth's sphericity

65242.question_text: Which of the following types of rock is a source of energy?

65243.explanation: Rail transport is the slowest and cheapest means of transort

65244.explanation: Lack of technical know-how and poor maintenance is a limitation or problem of rail transport in developing countries

65246.explanation: The north atlantic route is the busiest and most important route that links two most populous and heavily industrialized parts of the world i.e western europe and eastern part of north america

65248.explanation: poor visibility is a perculiar problem to air and ocean transportation due to the formation of fog in the atmosphere

65252.explanation: A state is formed from the combination of several local government areas

65253.explanation: It takes eighty-eight days for mercury to complete its orbit

options.text: The dominance of cold currents in the region
The shape and direction of the shoreline

65260.explanation: An advantage of chain surveying is that it can be used to survey a large area

65262.explanation: When the framework forms a closed figure or when the traverse connects two stations, whose positions are known, it is called a closed traverse

65263.explanation: The watkin's clinometer is used to measure the angles of ground slopes
